price_construction.open_high_low: raw field multiplied by adjusted_close divided by raw close on the same row
price_construction.vwap: split-adjusted typical-price proxy: (adjusted high + adjusted low + adjusted close) / 3
price_construction.volume: source volume without a split-volume reconstruction
price_construction.tradable_mask: finite positive adjusted OHLC, finite nonnegative volume, and internally consistent high/low
price_construction.warning: The public snapshot has no true VWAP or point-in-time constituent history; this is retrospective ETF factor research.

factor_treatment.implementation: execute the pinned repository implementation inside the qualified Podman image
factor_treatment.joint_mask: repository intersection of the six selected factor masks
factor_treatment.all_213_factor_use: coverage, finiteness, and runtime audit only; no performance-based selection
factor_treatment.direction_selection: choose +1 or -1 solely from the sign of development-period mean rank IC

target.label: one-session forward adjusted-close return
target.metric: daily cross-sectional Spearman rank information coefficient
target.interpretation: signal-quality diagnostic only; close-to-next-close IC is not an executable close-price backtest

uncertainty.bootstrap: fixed-length circular moving blocks over daily IC observations

next_stage.portfolio_backtest: Only factors passing this fixed gate may enter a separately predeclared causal portfolio experiment.
